n1.heard: Midnight, the night of the new moon.

n2.heard: A blackout hits the Belmont Museum.

n3.heard: When the lights come back, the Belmont Star is gone, a 40 karat diamond.

n4.heard: Three people were inside the cleaner.

s1.heard: I was mopping the East Hall.  I didn't hear a thing.

s2.heard: I was in my office, reading by Candelight.

s3.heard: I saw the thief run past the window.  His face was clear as day in the moonlight.

n8.heard: Did you catch it? There was no moonlight. It was a new moon.
